# `admin.inbox.test`

Send a test admin notice to a user

Site admins only. No inbox store ships in v1, so the test notice lands in the domain audit log, where admin.audit.list shows it immediately.

- Method and path: `POST /admin/inbox/test`
- Scope: `admin:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie admin inbox test`
- MCP: `admin_inbox_test`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | body | no | `string` |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `user` | body | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`forbidden`, `not-found`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
